[[Category:Social psychology]]
'''Script''', in [[social psychology]], describes an individual's understanding of their [[social role]]s and associated [[social norm]]s in a given context.

<ref>{{#cite:Q3470}}</ref>

{{Hidden example}}
The '''script''' of a client walking into a restaurant most likely involve being received by staff, sat down at a table, have their order taken, being served what they ordered, and ask for the bill and pay, not being ignored.
{{End hidden}}
